name: BiggerPockets

sources.title: Community/forum rules — read via search index because direct fetch returned 403; prohibits contact info/links in posts, affiliate links anywhere, and promotion outside designated forums
Welcome thread (search-indexed) — self-promotion allowed only in designated forums; members are asked to introduce themselves

conditions: Free basic membership exists, but any company/product mention is treated as advertising and is confined to signatures and designated areas (Marketplace/Classifieds, member blogs, intro thread)
Only relevant for real-estate-adjacent products — the community is exclusively real-estate investing
requirements: Real-estate investing relevance — generic SaaS promotion has no home here
No contact information (email, phone, social handles, website links) in forum posts — it must go in the signature instead
No affiliate links anywhere on the site including signatures, blogs, messages
Basic members may only private-message colleagues; PMs may never contain solicitations or links to your site
Posts advertising your company, services or website outside the designated areas are edited/removed by moderators
preparation: Profile photo and a genuine intro post (location, investing goals)
Signature with website link — the only sanctioned place for it
Real-estate-relevant value to contribute (deal analysis, market knowledge) before any promotion
workflow: Register a free account at biggerpockets.com/signup (use a browser — the site 403s automated fetches)
Upload a profile picture and post an introduction in the welcome forum
Set website/contact info in the signature, not in posts
Contribute to real-estate threads; if the product is relevant to investors, promote only in the Marketplace/Classifieds or via member blog posts
Paid tiers (Pro/Plus) expand private-messaging reach but do not relax the promotion rules
watchFor: Aggressive moderation — posts with links/contact info are edited without notice
PM solicitation rules are enforced even for Pro members — cold outreach with links can get messaging blocked
Mentioning your company or what it does can itself be classified as advertising outside permitted areas
Site blocks automated fetches — verify current rules in a browser before participating
countsAsLive: A public member profile exists at biggerpockets.com/users/<name> with signature link set and at least one published post
unknowns: Whether member profile pages are indexable / whether profile links are nofollow
Which marketplace sub-forums accept software/service ads specifically
